C0886.title: Suspected Leak of 170 Million User Records from Chaoxing Learning Platform
C0886.summary: In June 2022, a database allegedly containing over 170 million records from the Chinese college learning app 'Chaoxing' was offered for sale online. The company stated it does not store plaintext passwords but confirmed it had reported the incident to police, who have launched an investigation.

references.title: Major Data Security and Personal Information Leak Incidents in China in the First Half of 2022
